title: PIRLS 2021 International Database
descriptions: The PIRLS 2021 database includes student achievement data as well as student, home, teacher, school, and national context data for 57 countries and 8 benchmarking participants participating in PIRLS 2021. The files also contain curriculum data, codebooks and data almanacs.
